items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I'd grab the horn oh he'd grab it he'd play and I'd play and I'd play together like that

ctx.x: from Johnny Sincere. Johnny Sincere played, when he came back from playing with Louis he came right there and played with me. Well he did was he? Yeah Johnny Sincere was playing with me. He was playing guitar with me. Yeah. He's going back California. Yes he's. He came here, built a home, stayed there and he played out all around. Then he turned around, made up his mind, go back, sold the home and went back to California.
It looks like a fest isn't going to come today. I wanted to ask did you ever play with Professor Mineta?

Oh no more than around his house or out somewhere at some friends house. Never any jobs. We had no fun just like right now. We take one two little drinks somebody get to singing. I'd grab the horn oh he'd grab it he'd play and I'd play and we'd play together like that or something like that. That's the only way. But another thing he played with the girl I'm telling you about Helen Edwards at the Saint Sue Hall. That's where fest was playing with her. Up on Howard. Yeah on Howard Street for Old Man Riley at Saint…
